title: Deployment
description: Deployment enables declarative updates for Pods and ReplicaSets.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object, apps/v1 for a Deployment.

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents, Deployment here.

spec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of the Deployment.

status.description: Most recently observed status of the Deployment, populated by the system.

ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is metadata that all persisted resources must have, which includes all objects users must create.

name.description: Name must be unique within a namespace and is required when creating resources.

namespace.description: Namespace defines the space within which each name must be unique; empty means the "default" namespace.

labels.description: Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects.

additionalProperties.description: A label value, at most 63 characters.

annotations.description: Unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata.

uid.description: UID is the unique in time and space value for this object, generated by the server on creation.

resourceVersion.description: An opaque value that represents the internal version of this object, used by clients to determine when objects have changed.

generation.description: A sequence number representing a specific generation of the desired state, populated by the system.

creationTimestamp.description: A timestamp representing the server time when this object was created, set by the system.

managedFields.description: Maps workflow-id and version to the set of fields that are managed by that workflow, for internal housekeeping.

DeploymentSpec.description: DeploymentSpec is the specification of the desired behavior of the Deployment.

replicas.description: Number of desired pods, distinguishing an explicit zero from not specified.

selector.description: Label selector for pods, which must match the pod template's labels; it is immutable after creation.

template.description: Template describes the pods that will be created.

strategy.description: The deployment strategy to use to replace existing pods with new ones.

minReadySeconds.description: Minimum number of seconds for which a newly created pod should be ready without any of its containers crashing, for it to be considered available.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: The number of old ReplicaSets to retain to allow rollback.

progressDeadlineSeconds.description: The maximum time in seconds for a deployment to make progress before it is considered to be failed.

paused.description: Indicates that the deployment is paused, so changes to the pod template do not trigger a rollout.

DeploymentStrategy.description: DeploymentStrategy describes how to replace existing pods with new ones.

rollingUpdate.description: Rolling update config params, present only if type is RollingUpdate.

RollingUpdateDeployment.description: Spec to control the desired behavior of rolling update.

maxSurge.description: The maximum number of pods that can be scheduled above the desired number of pods, as a number or a percentage of desired pods.

maxUnavailable.description: The maximum number of pods that can be unavailable during the update, as a number or a percentage of desired pods.

LabelSelector.description: A label query over a set of resources, where the results of matchLabels and matchExpressions are ANDed.

matchLabels.description: A map of {key,value} pairs, each equivalent to a matchExpressions element with operator "In" and that single value.

matchExpressions.description: A list of label selector requirements, which are ANDed.

items.description: A selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that relates the key and values.

key.description: The label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description: Represents a key's relationship to a set of values.

values.description: An array of string values, non-empty for In and NotIn and empty for Exists and DoesNotExist.

PodTemplateSpec.description: PodTemplateSpec describes the data a pod should have when created from a template.

metadata.description: Standard object's metadata for the pods: their labels must match the selector.

spec.description: Specification of the desired behavior of the pod.

PodSpec.description: PodSpec is a description of a pod.

containers.description: List of containers belonging to the pod; there must be at least one.

initContainers.description: List of initialization containers belonging to the pod, run in order before the app containers start.

volumes.description: List of volumes that can be mounted by containers belonging to the pod.

serviceAccountName.description: The name of the ServiceAccount to use to run this pod.

nodeSelector.description: A selector which must be true for the pod to fit on a node: the node's labels must match every key and value.

additionalProperties.description: The node label value to match.

restartPolicy.description: Restart policy for all containers within the pod; Deployments only allow Always, which the API server enforces.

dnsPolicy.description: Set DNS policy for the pod.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Optional duration in seconds the pod needs to terminate gracefully.

affinity.description: If specified, the pod's scheduling constraints: node affinity, pod affinity and pod anti-affinity.

tolerations.description: If specified, the pod's tolerations, which let it schedule onto nodes with matching taints.

securityContext.description: SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes and common container settings.

imagePullSecrets.description: An optional list of references to secrets in the same namespace to use for pulling any of the images used by this pod.

items.description: A reference to a secret in the same namespace.

Container.description: A single application container that you want to run within a pod.

name.description: Name of the container specified as a DNS_LABEL, unique within the pod.

image.description: Container image name, which the API server requires for a Deployment's containers.

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy, defaulting to Always for the :latest tag and IfNotPresent otherwise.

command.description: Entrypoint array, not executed within a shell; the image's ENTRYPOINT is used if this is not provided.

args.description: Arguments to the entrypoint; the image's CMD is used if this is not provided.

workingDir.description: Container's working directory, the runtime's default when not specified.

ports.description: List of ports to expose from the container.

env.description: List of environment variables to set in the container.

envFrom.description: List of sources to populate environment variables in the container.

resources.description: Compute resources required by this container.

volumeMounts.description: Pod volumes to mount into the container's filesystem.

livenessProbe.description: Periodic probe of container liveness; the container is restarted if the probe fails.

readinessProbe.description: Periodic probe of container service readiness; the container is removed from service endpoints if the probe fails.

startupProbe.description: Indicates that the pod has successfully initialized; no other probes run until it succeeds.

securityContext.description: SecurityContext defines the security options the container should be run with.

ContainerPort.description: ContainerPort represents a network port in a single container.

containerPort.description: Number of the port to expose on the pod's IP address, between 1 and 65535.

name.description: If specified, an IANA_SVC_NAME unique within the pod that services can refer to.

protocol.description: Protocol for the port: UDP, TCP, or SCTP.

hostPort.description: Number of the port to expose on the host; most containers do not need this.

EnvVar.description: EnvVar represents an environment variable present in a container.

name.description: Name of the environment variable, which must be a C_IDENTIFIER.

value.description: The variable's value, in which $(VAR_NAME) references to previously defined variables are expanded.

valueFrom.description: Source for the environment variable's value, which cannot be used if value is not empty.

configMapKeyRef.description: Selects a key of a ConfigMap.

optional.description: Specify whether the ConfigMap or its key must be defined.

secretKeyRef.description: Selects a key of a secret in the pod's namespace.

key.description: The key of the secret to select from.

optional.description: Specify whether the Secret or its key must be defined.

fieldRef.description: Selects a field of the pod, such as metadata.name, metadata.namespace or status.podIP.

fieldPath.description: Path of the field to select in the specified API version.

apiVersion.description: Version of the schema the fieldPath is written in terms of, "v1" by default.

resourceFieldRef.description: Selects a resource of the container, such as limits.cpu or requests.memory.

containerName.description: Container name, optional for environment variables.

divisor.description: Specifies the output format of the exposed resources, "1" by default.

EnvFromSource.description: EnvFromSource represents the source of a set of ConfigMaps or Secrets.

optional.description: Specify whether the ConfigMap must be defined.
Specify whether the Secret must be defined.

prefix.description: An optional identifier to prepend to each key in the ConfigMap or Secret, which must be a C_IDENTIFIER.

ResourceRequirements.description: ResourceRequirements describes the compute resource requirements.

limits.description: Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.

requests.description: Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required, defaulting to limits when those are set.

VolumeMount.description: VolumeMount describes a mounting of a Volume within a container.

name.description: This must match the name of a volume.

mountPath.description: Path within the container at which the volume should be mounted, which must not contain ':'.

readOnly.description: Mounted read-only if true, read-write otherwise.

subPath.description: Path within the volume from which the container's volume should be mounted, the volume's root by default.

Probe.description: Probe describes a health check to be performed against a container to determine whether it is alive or ready to receive traffic.

httpGet.description: HTTPGet specifies an HTTP GET request to perform.

path.description: Path to access on the HTTP server.

port.description: Name or number of the port to access on the container.

scheme.description: Scheme to use for connecting to the host.

tcpSocket.description: TCPSocket specifies a connection to a TCP port.

port.description: Number or name of the port to access on the container.

host.description: Optional host name to connect to, the pod IP by default.

exec.description: Exec specifies a command to execute in the container.

command.description: The command line to execute inside the container, not run in a shell.

grpc.description: GRPC specifies a gRPC health check request.

port.description: Port number of the gRPC service.

service.description: The name of the service to place in the gRPC HealthCheckRequest.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Number of seconds after the container has started before probes are initiated.

periodSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, to perform the probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Number of seconds after which the probe times out.

successThreshold.description: Minimum consecutive successes for the probe to be considered successful after having failed; 1 for liveness and startup.

failureThreshold.description: Minimum consecutive failures for the probe to be considered failed after having succeeded.

Volume.description: Volume represents a named volume in a pod that may be accessed by any container in the pod.

name.description: Name of the volume, a DNS_LABEL unique within the pod.

configMap.description: ConfigMap represents a configMap that should populate this volume.

items.description: Projects the listed keys into the volume as files; unlisted keys are not present.
Maps a string key to a path within a volume.

path.description: The relative path of the file to map the key to.

mode.description: Optional mode bits used to set permissions on this file.

optional.description: Specify whether the ConfigMap or its keys must be defined.

defaultMode.description: Mode bits used to set permissions on created files by default.

secret.description: Secret represents a secret that should populate this volume.

secretName.description: Name of the secret in the pod's namespace to use.

optional.description: Specify whether the Secret or its keys must be defined.

persistentVolumeClaim.description: A reference to a PersistentVolumeClaim in the same namespace.

claimName.description: The name of a PersistentVolumeClaim in the same namespace as the pod using this volume.

readOnly.description: Will force the ReadOnly setting in VolumeMounts.

emptyDir.description: EmptyDir represents a temporary directory that shares a pod's lifetime.

medium.description: What type of storage medium should back this directory: "" for the node's default, or "Memory".

sizeLimit.description: Total amount of local storage required for this EmptyDir volume.

hostPath.description: HostPath represents a pre-existing file or directory on the host machine that is directly exposed to the container.

path.description: Path of the directory on the host.

type.description: Type for the HostPath volume, "" by default.

projected.description: Items for all-in-one resources: secrets, configmaps, and downward API.

DeploymentStatus.description: DeploymentStatus is the most recently observed status of the Deployment.

observedGeneration.description: The generation observed by the deployment controller.

replicas.description: Total number of non-terminating pods targeted by this deployment (their labels match the selector).

updatedReplicas.description: Total number of non-terminating pods targeted by this deployment that have the desired template spec.

readyReplicas.description: Total number of non-terminating pods targeted by this deployment with a Ready condition.

availableReplicas.description: Total number of available non-terminating pods (ready for at least minReadySeconds) targeted by this deployment.

unavailableReplicas.description: Total number of unavailable pods targeted by this deployment.

conditions.description: Represents the latest available observations of a deployment's current state.

DeploymentCondition.description: DeploymentCondition describes the state of a deployment at a certain point.

status.description: Status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

reason.description: The reason for the condition's last transition.

message.description: A human readable message indicating details about the transition.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

lastUpdateTime.description: The last time this condition was updated.
